stateOwner: one serial media executor; production device-worker scheduling is excluded

invariants.format: one platform-neutral PcmFormat is shared by FFmpeg conversion and WASAPI validation
invariants.decoder: video and audio reuse one receive-before-supply packet and codec drain state machine
invariants.resampler: one reader owns and reuses one SwrContext; source format changes are refused
invariants.timestamps: the first source PTS maps once with floor rounding, then actual output sample counts advance a contiguous cursor
invariants.sourceStart: an exact project-frame start seeks the audio stream, bounds pre-target decode, trims one crossing output block, and publishes the exact target source PTS as the clock anchor
invariants.drain: codec EOF is followed by null-input swresample drain until no sample remains
invariants.backpressure: one pending decoded block is sliced into bounded admissions without re-decoding
invariants.generation: a replacement reader opens before the active generation, queue, or pending block changes
invariants.cancellation: cancellation terminates and clears only the current generation
invariants.wasapiLease: non-EOS shortage may add silence; EOS requests and releases the exact remaining media frames
invariants.evidence: captured injected WASAPI media bytes equal a separate direct canonical decode byte for byte

excluded: production decode-executor to STA WASAPI-worker scheduling
interactive scrub, speed change, and time stretch
AAC or MP3 priming and trailing padding
